UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_dups', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), '' FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28'

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns, count(DISTINCT business_date) days_with_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns, count(*) days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns mine, c.ns ctl, round(m.ns-c.ns,2) diff, m.days_with_sales, c.days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.ns,0)) DESC

WITH per AS (
  SELECT MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2
),
trading AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store st
  CROSS JOIN dim_date d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.is_trading_day
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2
),
sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       t.store_id, t.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       ROUND(s.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM trading t JOIN sales s ON s.store_id=t.store_id
ORDER BY rank
